tips: Focus on the primary reason for contact
Always link correct issue type to interaction type
When in doubt, consult with team lead
In reopen/new issue/update cases, adjust issue type if needed

issue_types.path: Account > Account Security > Data Security & Privacy
issue_types.use_case: Customer inquiries about how Tamara collects, protects, and manages personal data.
includes: what personal data Tamara collects stores or shares
how bank account or card details are protected
request deletion of data GDPR PDPL
who has access to account data

issue_types.path: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
issue_types.use_case: Customer suspects National ID or identity was used on Tamara without consent.
includes: account or orders created using their National ID they did not initiate
unauthorized activity linked to identity National ID Nafath Absher Yakeen UAEKYC
someone created or used Tamara account using their identity
does_not_include: phone number already registered without identity misuse → Phone Number Already in Use
login access recovery without identity misuse

issue_types.path: Account > Account Security > Unrecognized Login
issue_types.use_case: Suspicious or unauthorized activity related to accessing Tamara account.
includes: someone else gained or attempting access
OTP SMS push they did not request

issue_types.path: Account > ID verification
issue_types.use_case: Unable to complete or questions about identity verification.

issue_types.path: Account > Passcode
issue_types.use_case: Difficulty with Tamara account passcode.
includes: how to set up manage passcode

issue_types.path: Account > Registration & login
issue_types.use_case: Unable to sign up or log in, or general registration questions.
includes: app crashes blank screens errors during login
redirected to new account creation instead of existing

issue_types.path: Account > Registration & login > Phone number already in use
issue_types.use_case: Phone number already registered; ownership/access without identity misuse.
includes: phone number already in use during registration
do not recall creating account with that number
recover access to account linked to number
does_not_include: unauthorized accounts or National ID → National ID Fraud

issue_types.path: Account > Registration & login > Didn't receive the login / registration OTP
issue_types.issue_type: Didn't receive the login / registration OTP
issue_types.use_case: Not receiving or delayed OTP for signup/login.

issue_types.path: Account > Authentication > MFA - Verification Failure
issue_types.use_case: Unable to complete MFA due to failure in authentication step.

issue_types.path: Account > Authentication > MFA - Add / remove trusted device
issue_types.use_case: Add, remove, or manage trusted device for MFA.

issue_types.path: Account > Update Account > Change phone number
issue_types.use_case: Update phone number linked to Tamara account.
includes: cannot change number due to active order or balance

issue_types.path: Account > Update Account > Change Email
issue_types.use_case: Update email linked to Tamara account.

issue_types.path: Account > Update Account > Delete account
issue_types.use_case: Permanently close Tamara account.

issue_types.path: Account > Update Account > Reactivate account
issue_types.use_case: Restore access to deactivated account.

issue_types.path: Legal and Government > Credit Bureau > Credit Bureau Process & Report
issue_types.use_case: Inquiries/complaints about Tamara credit bureau reporting.
includes: whether Tamara reports to credit bureau
why reported to SIMAH or AECB
paid dues but bureau still shows balance

issue_types.path: Legal and Government > Shariah compliance
issue_types.use_case: Whether Tamara products comply with Islamic finance.

issue_types.path: Order > Merchant fraud
issue_types.use_case: Merchant intentionally deceived or scam suspected.
does_not_include: wrong damaged item from legitimate merchant → Item Not As Described
missing delayed undelivered → Item or Order Not Delivered

issue_types.path: Order > Merchant Fraud > Extra Fees
issue_types.use_case: Merchant charged undisclosed fees.
includes: minimum purchase for Tamara not disclosed

issue_types.path: Order > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Required Documents
issue_types.use_case: Issues with documents for Pay by Finance (Murabha) signing.
includes: did not receive documents to sign
unable to open view sign documents
questions about what they are signing

issue_types.path: Order > Murabha - Pay by Finance > Signed contract
issue_types.use_case: Request copy of signed Pay by Finance contract.
includes: need contract for records legal financial

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Can't see Tamara as a payment option
issue_types.issue_type: Can't see Tamara as a payment option
issue_types.use_case: Cannot see or access Tamara at merchant checkout.
includes: Tamara on website but not app or vice versa
does_not_include: only PIF no installments → Can't See Split Payment Options (only PIF)

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Didn't receive the order OTP
issue_types.use_case: OTP for confirming order not received or delayed.

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Instore - did not receive the payment link SMS
issue_types.issue_type: Instore - did not receive the payment link SMS
issue_types.use_case: In-store payment link SMS not received or unusable.
includes: did not receive payment link SMS in-store

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Maximum/minimum purchase limit
issue_types.use_case: Questions about purchase limit / pre-qualification.
includes: previously higher limit now too low

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Order verification IVR call
issue_types.use_case: Issues with order verification IVR call.
includes: missed call order on hold cancelled

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Declined order
issue_types.use_case: Order not approved / why declined.
does_not_include: stuck order → Cannot See Order (Stuck Order)
payment method failing → Unable to Pay Pending Dues

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an order > cannot see order (expired order)
issue_types.use_case: Order expired before completed/confirmed.

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > cannot see order (stuck order)
issue_types.use_case: Checkout completed but order not appearing/processing correctly.
includes: authorized approved but merchant not fulfilled
down payment charged merchant no record
order in Tamara merchant no record
charged by Tamara no merchant confirmation

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Chose the wrong installment plan
issue_types.use_case: Selected wrong payment plan and wants to change.
includes: PIF instead of instalments or vice versa
cancel and re-place with correct plan

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Link Bank Account
issue_types.use_case: Questions/issues linking bank for credit verification.

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > can't see a specific split payment option (X)
issue_types.issue_type: can't see a specific split payment option (X)
issue_types.use_case: Specific instalment plan missing while others visible.
includes: previously had plan no longer showing
not eligible for specific split option
plan at some merchants not others
does_not_include: no Tamara at all → Can't see Tamara as payment option
only PIF → Can't see split payment options (only PIF)

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Can't see Tamara's split payment options (only PIF)
issue_types.issue_type: Can't see Tamara's split payment options (only PIF)
issue_types.use_case: Only Pay in Full offered, no instalments.
includes: instalments on some merchants not others
does_not_include: Tamara not appearing → Can't see Tamara as payment option
SiX missing but others visible → specific split option

issue_types.path: Order > Placing an Order > Can't see a specific split payment option (SiX)
issue_types.issue_type: Can't see a specific split payment option (SiX)
issue_types.use_case: Some split options available but expected one (e.g. Si4) missing.

issue_types.path: Order > Dispute > Cancel dispute
issue_types.use_case: Withdraw or cancel a previously raised dispute.
does_not_include: cancel return/order not dispute → Refunds or Return/Cancellation Not Processed

issue_types.path: Order > Dispute > Item not as described
issue_types.use_case: Item does not match expectation without clear intentional fraud.

issue_types.path: Order > Dispute > Item or order not delivered
issue_types.use_case: Delayed missing undelivered order; merchant assumed legitimate.

issue_types.path: Order > Dispute > Canceled by merchant but not reflected in Tamara
issue_types.issue_type: Canceled by merchant but not reflected in Tamara
issue_types.use_case: Merchant confirmed cancellation but Tamara not updated.
does_not_include: waiting merchant action → Return/Cancellation Not Processed

issue_types.path: Order > Dispute > Return/cancellation not processed
issue_types.use_case: Return/cancel requested but merchant not processed yet.
does_not_include: merchant-confirmed not in Tamara → Canceled by merchant but not reflected

issue_types.path: Other > Feedback > New feature or product request
issue_types.use_case: Suggesting or requesting a new feature/product.
does_not_include: general app feedback → Feedback About Tamara

issue_types.path: Other > Feedback > New merchant request
issue_types.use_case: Want Tamara at a merchant that does not accept Tamara yet.
includes: why merchant does not accept Tamara
does_not_include: feedback about existing merchant → Customer feedback about merchant

issue_types.path: Other > Could not find a relevant issue type
issue_types.sub_category: Could not find a relevant issue type
issue_types.issue_type: Could not find a relevant issue type
issue_types.use_case: Contact does not fit any existing issue type after review.

issue_types.path: Other > Related to Collection agency
issue_types.use_case: Contacted by collection agency or concerns about collection.
does_not_include: credit bureau SIMAH/AECB → Credit Bureau Process & Report

issue_types.path: Other > Customer feedback about merchant
issue_types.use_case: General feedback about a merchant not tied to a specific order.
does_not_include: order-specific → Merchant Fraud or Dispute type

issue_types.path: Other > About Tamara (General)
issue_types.use_case: Truly general questions about Tamara.

issue_types.path: Other > Feedback > Feedback about Tamara
issue_types.use_case: General feedback about app or overall experience.
does_not_include: specific new feature → New feature or product request

issue_types.path: Other > Incomplete Contact > Authentication failed
issue_types.use_case: Closed because customer could not be authenticated.

issue_types.path: Other > Incomplete Contact > Call/chat connection issue
issue_types.use_case: Call/chat disconnected before completion unintentionally.

issue_types.path: Other > Incomplete Contact > Call/chat dropped
issue_types.use_case: Persistent technical connection problem.

issue_types.path: Other > Contact from merchant
issue_types.use_case: Contact initiated by a merchant rather than customer.

issue_types.path: Other > Incomplete Contact > No response from customer
issue_types.use_case: Customer did not respond within expected timeframe.

issue_types.path: Other > Test contact
issue_types.use_case: Internal system/process test contact.

issue_types.path: Other > Spam
issue_types.use_case: Unsolicited non-support junk.

issue_types.path: Other > Vulnerable Customer > Deceased Customer Case
issue_types.use_case: Family/representative reporting account holder passed away.

issue_types.path: Other > Vulnerable Customer > Customer with total physical disability
issue_types.use_case: Physical disability affecting independent use of Tamara.

issue_types.path: Other > Vulnerable Customer > Customer with total financial disability
issue_types.use_case: Severe financial hardship affecting payments.
does_not_include: technical pay error → Unable to Pay Pending Dues

issue_types.path: Other > Fraudulent / Misleading Ads
issue_types.use_case: Ad believed fraudulent inaccurate or impersonating Tamara.
includes: report suspicious ad using Tamara branding
does_not_include: general marketing feedback → Feedback About Tamara

issue_types.path: Other > Campaign Post
issue_types.use_case: Contact about a specific campaign post or promo.
does_not_include: general marketing feedback → Feedback About Tamara

issue_types.path: Other > Competition Post > No Reply Needed
issue_types.use_case: SM team resolving competition case that needs no reply.

issue_types.path: Outbound > Outbound calling campaign
issue_types.use_case: Tamara-initiated outbound calling campaign contact.

issue_types.path: Payment > Other
issue_types.use_case: General payment questions that fit no specific Payment sub-category.

issue_types.path: Payment > High Downpayment
issue_types.use_case: Surprised by or questions about down payment amount.
includes: down payment changed between view and confirm

issue_types.path: Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge date
issue_types.use_case: Questions about autocharge date.

issue_types.path: Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge Amount
issue_types.use_case: Questions about autocharge amount.

issue_types.path: Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge card
issue_types.use_case: Which card used for autocharge.

issue_types.path: Payment > Autocharge > Other
issue_types.use_case: Autocharge issues not date/amount/card.

issue_types.path: Payment > Late fee
issue_types.use_case: Questions/concerns about late fee.

issue_types.path: Payment > Chargeback
issue_types.use_case: Chargeback initiated or considered via bank.

issue_types.path: Payment > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Profit Rates
issue_types.use_case: Questions about Murabha profit rate.

issue_types.path: Payment > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Early Settlement
issue_types.use_case: Settle Murabha balance early.

issue_types.path: Payment > Payment Methods > Card is not accepted
issue_types.use_case: Card rejected or not working on Tamara.

issue_types.path: Payment > Payment Methods > How to add/remove a card
issue_types.use_case: Help managing payment cards.
includes: cannot find add remove cards in app

issue_types.path: Payment > Unrecognized charge > Suspected fraud
issue_types.use_case: Unauthorized Tamara charge believed fraudulent.

issue_types.path: Payment > Unrecognized charge > Duplicate charge
issue_types.use_case: Charged more than once for same transaction/instalment.

issue_types.path: Payment > Unrecorded charges > Other unrecorded charge issues
issue_types.use_case: Unrecorded charge issues not fitting other sub-categories.

issue_types.path: Payment > Postpone payment
issue_types.use_case: Delay or reschedule upcoming payment.
does_not_include: technical pay error → Unable to Pay

issue_types.path: Payment > Customer Processing Fees
issue_types.use_case: Questions about processing fee on order.

issue_types.path: Payment > Unable to pay pending dues
issue_types.use_case: Difficulty paying due instalments.
includes: pay now greyed out page fail
payment method not accepted for instalments

issue_types.path: Promotions & Cashback > Cashback
issue_types.use_case: Questions/concerns about cashback.

issue_types.path: Promotions & Cashback > Discount
issue_types.use_case: Discount or promo code issues.

issue_types.sub_category: How to return/cancel an order or item

issue_types.use_case: Guidance on how to return/cancel; informational only.
includes: what happens to instalment if return
does_not_include: already submitted not actioned → Return/Cancellation Not Processed

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Merchant incorrectly canceled the order/item
issue_types.use_case: Merchant canceled without customer request/consent.

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Incorrect refund amount
issue_types.use_case: Refund amount does not match expectation.

issue_types.use_case: Refund initiated but failed to reach account.
does_not_include: processed cannot locate → Refund Already Processed

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund already processed
issue_types.use_case: Asking about refund already processed on Tamara side.
includes: believe not received but sent to bank card wallet

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund not processed
issue_types.use_case: Waiting for refund not yet processed by Tamara.
includes: merchant-confirmed return tamara not processed refund

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Wallet refund
issue_types.use_case: Refund credited to Tamara wallet questions.
includes: wallet refund to bank card instead
why refund to wallet not original method

issue_types.path: Refunds and Cancellations > Refund Blocked by Merchant
issue_types.use_case: Refund cannot process because merchant blocked/unable.
